snippet.title: Yet Another Zombie Survivors - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2163330
Xbox One & Series: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/yazs/9nck0fxql38f
PlayStation 4/5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10010467
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/yet_another_zombie_survivors
____________
Assemble your team and decide upon their enhancements to find the most efficient synergies against thousands of the undead!

What makes #YAZS stand out among other similar titles?

● assemble a 3-member squad (most games in the genre let you play only one character per run).
● unlock Survivors and create wild synergies in multiple different game modes.
● level up & pick perks, abilities, and nodes from 9 skill-trees that match your playstyle.
● keep an eye out for puns and easter eggs hidden absolutely everywhere.
● we drop regular updates.
